title: 第19章 银色剑气
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
周围的其他人，目睹这沧海桑田般的奇景，眼中也都流露出惊叹。

    路青梧与其他四位来自不同圣地世家的护山者，包括天璇圣女慕云曦，互相颔首示意。

    五人同时纵身飞至湖泊上空，分立五方。

    他们神情肃穆，双手迅速结印，口中念诵着阵文。

    随着他们的动作，庞大繁复的紫色阵纹如同活物般在他们脚下蔓延，最终形成一个覆盖了整个湖面的巨大光阵。

    符文流转，散发出浩瀚的空间波动。

    “苍山封印已启，为期十五日，过时不候！诸位，机缘险中求，务必谨慎！”

    路青梧威严的声音响彻四野，清晰地传入下方每一个准备进入苍山的修士耳中。

    话音未落，早已按捺不住的修士们纷纷祭起飞剑法宝，化作一道道流光，毫不犹豫地投入那看似平静的湖水之中。

    路青梧的目光落在路仙瑶身上，一道温和却带着浓浓担忧的传音在她耳边响起，“仙瑶，万事小心！苍山之内规则莫测，妖兽横行，更要提防人心险恶。”

    “青梧哥放心，我知道的。”路仙瑶点点头。

    随后，对身后的萧烬和墨燃以及四名护卫们说道：“我们走！”

    “是。”

    四名压制了修为至筑基期的结丹护卫齐声应命，紧随她身后。

    七人化作流光，投入那片倒映着蓝天白云的湛蓝湖水。

    穿过水面的刹那，并非想象中的冰冷湿漉，反而像是穿过了一层无形的镜面。

    眼前景象骤然颠倒变幻！

    没有预想的水下世界，迎接他们的竟是万丈高空！

    脚下是连绵起伏、郁郁葱葱的原始丛林，清新的草木气息和浓郁的灵气扑面而来。

    远处有一座巍峨的山脉，云雾缭绕。

    震耳欲聋的野兽嘶吼声不时从下方密林中传来，或有大片惊鸟被惊起，扑棱着翅膀慌乱地飞向远方。

    “哇！主人，我们是从天上掉下来的诶！”墨燃新奇地大叫起来，眼眸闪闪发光。

    路仙瑶也为这奇妙的穿越方式感到惊奇不已。

    如此秘境，红月上仙竟维持了上万年之久！

    忽然，一道凌厉无匹的银色剑气，毫无征兆地从下方一片茂密的树冠中激射而出，直逼他们方向而来！
content_en:
The other people around me also had wonder in their eyes when they witnessed this extraordinary sight.

    Lu Qingwu and four other mountain protectors from different Holy Land families, including Tianxuan Saint Mu Yunxi, nodded to each other.

    The five people jumped into the sky above the lake at the same time and separated into five directions.

    They looked solemn, quickly formed seals with their hands, and chanted the formation in their mouths.

    As they moved, huge and complex purple formations spread under their feet like living creatures, eventually forming a huge light formation covering the entire lake.

    The runes circulated, emitting vast spatial fluctuations.

    "The seal of Cangshan has been opened for fifteen days. Don't wait until it's too late! Everyone, be cautious when looking for opportunities in danger!"

    Lu Qingwu's majestic voice resounded throughout the countryside, clearly reaching the ears of every monk below who was preparing to enter Cangshan Mountain.

    Before he could finish his words, the monks who could no longer hold themselves back sacrificed their flying sword magic weapons one after another, turned them into streams of light, and threw them into the seemingly calm lake water without hesitation.

    Lu Qingwu's eyes fell on Lu Xianyao, and a gentle but worried voice sounded in her ears, "Xianyao, be careful! The rules in Cangshan are unpredictable, monsters are rampant, and you must be careful of the evil people's hearts."

    "Brother Qingwu, don't worry, I know." Lu Xianyao nodded.

    Then, he said to Xiao Jin, Mo Ran and the four guards behind him: "Let's go!"

    "Yes."

    The four Danjie guards who had suppressed their cultivation to the foundation-building stage responded in unison and followed her closely.

    The seven people turned into streams of light and plunged into the blue lake reflecting the blue sky and white clouds.

    The moment I passed through the water, it was not as cold and wet as I imagined, but rather as if I had passed through an invisible mirror.

    The scene in front of me suddenly changed upside down!

    There was no underwater world as they expected, and what greeted them was the sky thousands of feet high!

    Underfoot is the rolling, lush primeval jungle, with the fresh scent of vegetation and rich spiritual energy blowing towards your face.

    There is a towering mountain range in the distance, shrouded in clouds and mist.

    From time to time, deafening roars of beasts came from the dense forest below, or large numbers of frightened birds were frightened, flapping their wings and flying into the distance in panic.

    "Wow! Master, we fell from the sky!" Mo Ran shouted in novelty, his eyes sparkling.

    Lu Xianyao was also amazed by this wonderful way of crossing.

    The Red Moon Immortal has maintained such a secret realm for tens of thousands of years!

    Suddenly, a powerful silver sword energy shot out from the dense tree canopy below without any warning, heading straight towards their direction!
